tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Natural-language search across software products, capabilities (what software does) and replacement workflows. Understands synonyms, e.g. 'make thumbnails' finds YouTube thumbnail workflows. Returns ranked hits with URLs, plus the tool and capabilities the query most likely refers to.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full structured profile of a software product: plans and prices (with evidence status and verification date), capabilities with fit and limitations, honest reasons it's hard to replace, risks, related replacement workflows and sources.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: For a specific product (e.g. Canva), list each capability it provides and the best alternatives — ranking tools the user ALREADY owns first at $0 extra. Pass the capabilities the user actually uses (from get_tool) for a precise answer. Includes the honest case for keeping the tool.

tools.name: compare_solutions
tools.description: For one capability (e.g. 'youtube-thumbnails', 'crm-contacts', 'workflow-automation'), compare all known tools: fit, quality scores on the dimensions that matter, required skill, cheapest qualifying plan and limitations.

tools.name: find_workflows
tools.description: Find practical, step-by-step workflows that replace a paid tool or accomplish an outcome with tools the user already owns. Filter by tool being replaced, capability, or free-text query.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Full replacement guide: before/after, required tools and extra cost, setup steps, copyable prompts, templates/scripts, limitations, risks, a verification checklist to run BEFORE cancelling, and the savings methodology.

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: Given the outcomes the user needs (free text or capability slugs) and what they already own, recommend per-capability options (owned tools at $0 first) and a minimal stack covering everything, with incremental monthly cost and warnings about skill, collaboration and data sensitivity.

tools.name: estimate_savings
tools.description: Audit the user's subscriptions. For each: keep, downgrade, redundant, test_replacement, review_unused or keep_critical — with the arithmetic. Savings are split into 'likely' and 'possible' and never double-counted. Costs are what the user actually pays (monthly, all seats).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List plan prices for one tool or all tools, each with evidence status, verification date and source URL.
